caption: A player jumps high to block a spike, their hands impacting the ball forcefully, sending it back across the net.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A player jumps high to block a spike, their hands impacting the ball forcefully, sending it back across the net. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: A player must be positioned near the net, ready to jump and block the incoming spike.
The ball must be in motion toward the net, approaching the player's blocking area.
The player must extend their arms upward and make contact with the ball to redirect it.
The ball must be visibly propelled back across the net after the block.
